background: Bucknell Patriot League Player of the Year who played professionally in Europe before entering coaching through the Mike Budenholzer tree: Atlanta Hawks assistant (2014-18), Milwaukee Bucks assistant (2018-23, 2021 NBA champion) and Boston Celtics associate head coach under Joe Mazzulla (2023-24, 2024 NBA champion). Hired by Charlotte in May 2024 at age 39. Year one (2024-25) was a 19-63 injury-wrecked season with nightly rotation changes and a nightly 'defense first' message, but the Hornets ranked 2nd in 3PA. Year two (2025-26) produced a 25-win jump to 44-38, the franchise's best record since 2015-16, a top-three offense over the second half built on guard-to-guard screening, off-ball movement and a green light for LaMelo Ball, Brandon Miller and rookie Kon Knueppel; Charlotte beat Miami in OT in the play-in before losing to Orlando, one win short of the playoffs. Lee received Coach of the Year votes and a multiyear extension (May 2026). Analytics-driven on both ends: heavy 3PA volume, limiting corner threes, winning the possession battle, and managing Ball's load (bench role on back-to-backs).
